product_metadata.title: KitchenAid Burr Grinder , 7 oz, Onyx Black
features: Controlled rate grinding with 15 grind settings allows for excellent grind consistency and lower grinding temperatures.
Stainless steel cutting burrs offers durability and powerful performance.
7 oz. glass bean hopper and grind jar minimizes the static “cling” of coffee grinds.
The sleek, streamlined design allows it to be stored on your countertop or in a cabinet. Durable and easy to wipe clean.
Burrs turn at 450 rpm, minimizing frictional heat build-up and preserving flavor.
Includes Burr grinder, handheld scoop and burr cleaning brush.
description: Designed for the ultimate performance and reliability, the KitchenAid Burr Grinder uses stainless steel burrs to grind coffee consistently at any of the 15 available grind levels. The glass bean hopper holds up to seven ounces of whole beans that you can quickly grind for French Press coffee, automatic drip coffee makers, espresso or anything in between.
